headline: [Double-Tap Strike!] Russian Missiles Hit Zelensky's Hometown, [7-Year-Old] Among Dead
sub: Rescue worker killed, 60 wounded in Kryvyi Rih
caption:
⚠️ Double-Tap Strike! Russian Missiles Hit Zelensky's Hometown, 7-Year-Old Among Dead

A Russian strike hit the centre of Kryvyi Rih, President Volodymyr Zelensky's hometown in central Ukraine, on Friday night. Ukrainian officials said a 7-year-old boy and a 20-year-old rescue worker were killed.

🔹 60 people were wounded, including six children, said regional head Oleksandr Hanzha.
🔹 Ukrainian authorities called it a "double-tap" attack: a second strike hit as emergency crews arrived at the scene.
🔹 City head Oleksandr Vilkul said about 25 apartment buildings, a hospital and schools were damaged.

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera

headline: [Drone Attack!] Russian Cargo Ship Set on Fire in [Gulf of Finland]
sub: Crew evacuated as Finland alerts its allies
caption:
⚠️ Drone Attack! Russian Cargo Ship Set on Fire in Gulf of Finland

Two drones struck a cargo ship heading to Russia's Kaliningrad region in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday morning, officials said. Finland's Border Guard said the ship was on fire, and its crew was being evacuated.

🔹 Russian regional governor Alexander Drozdenko said the ship was hit by two drones about three nautical miles from Russia's border.
🔹 Finland said the burning ship drifted from international waters into Finnish waters. It limited air and sea traffic in the area as a precaution and informed its allies.
🔹 No one has claimed the attack. Kaliningrad's governor said supplies to the region are not at risk.

headline: [Tanker Attacks!] At Least [3 Oil Tankers] Hit Near Strait of Hormuz
sub: Iran also shows new missile launcher
caption:
⚠️ Tanker Attacks! At Least 3 Oil Tankers Hit Near Strait of Hormuz

At least three oil tankers were attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, AP reported. The UK's maritime agency UKMTO said two tankers leaving the Persian Gulf were hit by unidentified projectiles near Oman's Khasab.

🔹 One tanker was hit in the stern and one in the engine room. UKMTO said no casualties were reported.
🔹 Iran's navy said a tanker hit a naval mine east of the strait and caught fire. Iran did not comment on the UKMTO reports.
🔹 Iran's Revolutionary Guard also showed a new launcher on state TV that it says can fire two liquid-fuelled missiles at once.

Sources: AP, Reuters
